purpose: Original MECH POP 0.2.0 distant arena matte paintings; four distinct production assets
shared: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-quality wide 16:9 matte painting behind a 2.5D cute-mech arena fighter. Original futuristic anime world, elegant clean painterly detail, architectural depth, cinematic but cheerful. Camera looking nearly horizontally across the world, not down at a floor. Composition: keep central 60 percent low-detail and low-contrast; interesting architecture at the left and right edges, distant horizon near lower quarter. No characters, no UI, no text, no logos, no watermark. No foreground fighting platform: geometry will be rendered by the game. Full-bleed landscape image, 2560 by 1440 if possible. Keep the scenery softer and slightly lighter than crisp fighting characters will be.

arenas.neon_alley: NEON ALLEY: a playful neon rooftop district at violet-blue dusk. Tall layered buildings frame the extreme edges, magenta luminous vertical sign panels with abstract shapes and no writing, cyan conduits, tiny elevated trains far below. A distant dense futuristic skyline across the bottom, soft lavender atmosphere and a clear quiet opening through the middle. Rich violet, indigo, cyan and warm pink light; whimsical energetic urban night, no grim dystopia, no rain streaks over the center.
arenas.junk_fields: JUNK FIELDS: a grand sunny robot salvage yard on floating industrial islands at late afternoon. Sculptural heaps of colorful retired machine casings, giant cranes and suspended scrap magnets frame the far edges. Stacked ochre containers and turquoise machinery in the distant lower corners, floating islands on a dusty golden horizon. Open pale apricot sky across the central field, mint atmospheric haze, warm orange edge lighting. Wonder and friendly mechanical adventure, no rubbish photorealism, no smoke obscuring the middle.
arenas.blossom_core: BLOSSOM CORE: a serene futuristic garden city floating among pale clouds, immense pink cherry blossom trees at the left and right edges, luminous jade power cells nested in elegant white stone garden towers, curved terraces, small distant turquoise streams and hanging foliage. A luminous clear pale turquoise opening dominates the middle with subtle soft clouds; quiet far-off garden structures at the bottom. Petal pink, white ivory, fresh mint and soft sky cyan, airy spring daylight. A few tiny distant petals, never a dense foreground particle overlay.
arenas.reactor_ring: REACTOR RING: the vast interior of a beautiful clean science-fiction power station. An enormous luminous cyan circular accelerator arch rises around the outer left, upper, and right edges, concentric layered ribs framing a quiet deep-blue misty central space. Warm amber maintenance lights and small white-metal pylons near lower corners; distant glowing power core very small and low in the scene. Cool desaturated blue center, cyan and amber periphery, sense of immense scale, clean polished anime engineering. No hazard explosions, no bright focal flare in the fighting area, no floor in the foreground.
